nom: Avène Vitamin Activ Cg Radiance Intensive Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the cream as rich, hydrating, and well suited to winter or drier conditions, with soft, plumped, glowing results.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report the cream applied smoothly without irritation or damage, though one reviewer with reactive skin experienced burning and another had redness on retesting.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive combination skin reports a smooth, non-greasy application and a glass-skin finish, and another notes it balanced dry and oily areas of the face.
segments.mature: One reviewer recommends the cream especially for more mature facial skin, reporting plumper, happier-looking skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers looking for anti-aging benefits report smoother, plumper skin and one reviewer felt she looked younger, but effects are described as gradual rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers report the cream leaves skin hydrated, plump, and soft, often citing it as effective for dry or winter-dried skin.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation or redness, but one reviewer experienced burning and another reported irritation and redness recurring on a second use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cream as gentle and non-irritating for daily use, with several noting it worked well alongside other routine steps without disrupting their skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports lightened dark spots with continued use; most other reviewers do not mention pigmentation specifically.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the cream did not cause new breakouts; there is no other data on acne-prone skin in these reviews.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers frequently note the cream absorbs without a greasy residue, and one with combination skin says it helped balance oily and dry areas; one reviewer found it left a sticky or tacky feel.

extraits.texte: I never have odd reactions to skincare. This made me feel a strong burning sensation, just uncomfortable and weird, while it did nothing good for my facial skin.

This product had a nice scent and smooth texture. But for me it wasn't great, it made my skin irritated and I tried it 2 days later again and same redness occurred. I will not be buying this product in the future

Love this product have been using it every morning for the last 6 months along with the gentle cleanser and thermal water spray. I top it off with the tinted sun screen. My skin is clear, smooth and radiant!
This cream feels very luxurious and rich. My dry skin loved the moisture and I looked 10 years younger from the glow.

I just added this to my skincare routine - I didn't use it in place or anything. This product left my skin feeling soft and glowy. It didn't look greasy or feel sticky. I have sensitive combination skin and this went on smooth and left me with a glass skin look. I 10/10 would recommend this product. I'm a big texture and smell person so I easily throw out products and tend to be pretty picky.

extraits.titre: It keeps my skin radiant and soft
